seoTitle: Widows Bay Test: Which Character Are You? (10 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Widows Bay test: 10 everyday questions reveal whether you're Tom, Patricia, Wyck, Bechir, Evan or Rosemary. Get your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the skeptic who thinks there's a logical explanation for everything, the one who's been warning everybody for years, or the one who knows every bit of gossip on the island? Answer 10 everyday questions and find out which Widows Bay character you are.

characters.name: Tom Loftis
characters.title: The Stubborn Skeptic
characters.summary: Determined, practical and convinced there's a sensible explanation for everything, until there isn't.
description: Like Tom, you're a believer in facts. He's the mayor of Widows Bay, a newcomer from the mainland who's sure the town's superstitions are just bad for business.
You've got big plans and you'll sell them hard. Tom is desperate to bring tourists to the island, even while fog, curses and very strange locals keep getting in the way.
You carry more than you show. Tom is a widower raising a teenage son, and he struggles with drinking and a painful past, which doesn't help when the island starts testing him.
characters.flaw: You refuse to believe something until it's far too late.
characters.signature: A glossy tourist brochure in one hand and a very strong drink in the other.
characters.clashReason: they'd dismiss everything you believe as nonsense

characters.name: Patricia Moyer
characters.title: The Lonely Oddball
characters.summary: Eccentric, earnest and a little bit lonely. You've always been the odd one out, but you're braver than anyone gives you credit for.
description: Like Patricia, you march to your own beat. She's Tom's eccentric assistant and a poet, and she's never quite fitted in on the island.
People didn't believe you when it mattered. Patricia's old classmates were sure she'd made up her story about being hunted by the Boogeyman.
But you turn out to be the hero. Patricia found a grimoire disguised as a self-help book, and when the Boogeyman came back, she was the one who stopped him.
characters.flaw: You want to belong so badly that you'll go along with almost anything.
characters.signature: A notebook of poems, a very enthusiastic smile and a self-help book that definitely isn't one.
characters.clashReason: they'd try so hard to be your friend that it gets awkward

characters.name: Wyck Crawford
characters.title: The Island's Prophet
characters.summary: Salty, stubborn and usually right. You've been warning everyone for years, and you're not about to stop now.
description: Like Wyck, you know where you come from. He's a salty old fisherman whose family has lived on the island for centuries.
You believe what everyone else laughs off. Wyck has been insisting the island is cursed for years, and he clashes with Tom about it from day one.
Turns out you were right all along. Wyck ends up as the town's unofficial expert on the supernatural, part wise man and part lovable crank.
characters.flaw: You never, ever let anyone forget that you told them so.
characters.signature: A fishing boat, a spooky story and a loud "I told you so."
characters.clashReason: they'd lecture you about the old days for hours

characters.name: Bechir Clemmons
characters.title: The Steady Sheriff
characters.summary: Calm, sensible and protective of the community. You keep the peace, even when everything around you is falling apart.
description: Like Bechir, you're the voice of reason. He's the sheriff of Widows Bay, and he cares a great deal about the town and how it's seen.
You notice when people aren't coping. Bechir becomes more and more worried about Tom's behaviour as the strange events pile up.
Family comes first for you. Bechir's wife, Chelle, is pregnant, and on an island where terrible things happen, that's a lot to protect.
characters.flaw: You care so much about keeping the peace that you don't always ask the hard questions.
characters.signature: A sheriff's badge, a calm voice and a worried look at the mayor.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you to calm down and follow the rules

characters.name: Evan Loftis
characters.title: The Rebel
characters.summary: Restless, curious and always looking for trouble. You'd rather find out for yourself than be told what to do.
description: Like Evan, you're a thrill-seeker. Tom's teenage son is bored of island life and always looking for his next adventure, or his next excuse to get out of the house.
You're hurting more than you let on. Evan is still grieving the mother he never knew, and he doesn't find his dad easy to talk to.
You dig until you get the truth. Evan uncovers what really happened to his mother, and learns something about his own family that changes everything.
characters.flaw: You'd rather rebel than talk about how you feel.
characters.signature: Headphones on, sneaking out after dark, and definitely not telling his dad where.
characters.clashReason: they'd ignore every rule you set

characters.name: Rosemary
characters.title: The Town Gossip
characters.summary: Nosy, blunt and hugely entertaining. You know everybody's business, and you're happy to share it.
description: Like Rosemary, you know everything about everyone. She works in the mayor's office and can tell you exactly which neighbour has debts, secrets or worse.
You're the entertainment at work. Rosemary keeps her colleagues amused with a steady stream of stories, usually with a cigarette in hand.
You don't get rattled. While others panic about the island, Rosemary has usually heard it all before, and she has an opinion on all of it.
characters.flaw: No secret is safe with you.
characters.signature: A cigarette, a raised eyebrow and a story about someone's cousin.
characters.clashReason: your business would be all over town by lunchtime

questions.text: A new neighbour moves in. Within a week you...

options.text: Know their whole life story, and so does everyone else
Have warned them about everything that's ever gone wrong on the street
Have baked them something, hoping they'll be your friend
Have introduced yourself properly and checked they're settling in

questions.text: Someone tells you a spooky local legend. You...

options.text: Roll your eyes. There's a logical explanation for everything
Tell them three more they haven't heard
Go and check it out at midnight
Turn it into a poem

questions.text: Your boss has an idea that's clearly going to backfire. You...

options.text: Warn them, calmly, once
Say nothing, and get ready to enjoy the show
Back it enthusiastically. They need someone on their side
Tell them it's a terrible idea, and why

questions.text: It's Friday night and you're free. You...

options.text: Head out with friends to do something you probably shouldn't
Stay in writing, with a candle lit
Sit by the harbour with a drink, telling stories to anyone who'll listen
Spend hours on the phone catching up on everyone's news

questions.text: Something is really weighing on you. You...

options.text: Pour a drink and pretend it isn't
Look for a self-help book about it
Keep it to yourself so nobody else worries
Get out of the house. Anywhere but here

questions.text: You're trying to impress someone important. You...

options.text: Sell it hard. Everything's wonderful, don't look too closely
Try so hard that it gets a bit strange
Tell them the juiciest story you know
Don't bother. They'll take you as you are

questions.text: Nobody believes something you know is true. You...

options.text: Keep insisting, even though everyone thinks you made it up
Shrug. They'll find out the hard way
Quietly find proof before you say another word
Go and prove it yourself, however risky

questions.text: You find out a parent kept something huge from you for years. You...

options.text: Confront them. You deserve the truth
Try to understand. You've kept a few secrets yourself
Stay calm and ask them to explain everything
Wonder who else knew, and start asking around

questions.text: You're the mayor of a small island town trying to attract tourists. Strange things keep happening, and the locals say the island is cursed. You...

options.text: Keep the tourism campaign going. Curses aren't real
Warn the tourists. They deserve to know what they're walking into
Keep everyone calm. A panic would be worse than any curse
Quietly enjoy the chaos from your desk

questions.text: You live on a cursed island. You find an old book that seems to give you strange powers, but using it feels dangerous. You...

options.text: Use it. For once, people are paying attention to you
Study it carefully. You've waited years for proof like this
Try the scariest-looking spell first
Get rid of it. Nothing good can come from this
